tasks.title: Generate a report or invoice
tasks.summary: Build Word and PDF output from application data or an approved template.
tasks.boundary: Check placeholder completeness and the output's layout before delivery.

tasks.title: Convert Office files to PDF
tasks.summary: Turn a Word document, workbook, or presentation into a downloadable PDF.
tasks.boundary: Fonts and unsupported layout features can change the result; read the conversion diagnostics.

tasks.title: Merge, split, or reorder PDFs
tasks.summary: Select pages and produce a separate document while retaining the source.
tasks.boundary: Protected, signed, or unsupported inputs can restrict rewriting. Each tool reports its limits.

tasks.title: Extract content for search and AI
tasks.summary: Read text, tables, and source locations across document formats.
tasks.boundary: Scans need an optional OCR provider. Extracted text is not proof of original reading order.

tasks.title: Automate spreadsheet reporting
tasks.summary: Export objects and database results to Excel or CSV in repeatable scripts.
tasks.boundary: Use the module's documented runtime and provider requirements for your chosen data source.

tasks.title: Review and edit a PDF visually
tasks.summary: Keep the document in view while working with comments, forms, pages, and supported content.
tasks.boundary: Studio currently requires a source build. Public installers and native printer submission are not available.
